scope_note: Names beginning self. are per-player. Each client's state store holds its own player's values under these names; the host keeps every seat's copy, companions' included. Names beginning run. are shared and replicated by the host. The resolver runs once per client, on that client's store (DESIGN.md section 13).

state.name: run.humans
state.description: Human players at the start, 1-4.

state.name: run.companions
state.description: Companion brothers filling empty seats (4 minus humans).

state.name: self.seat
state.description: Per player: raft seat (a bow-left, b bow-right, c stern-left, d stern-right).

state.name: self.temperament
state.description: Per player: temperament chosen at the mark stone.

state.name: self.mark
state.description: Per player: the sign chosen at the mark stone.

state.name: self.counter_carved
state.description: Per player: carved his counter piece in s1_carve_counter.

state.name: run.counters_moves
state.description: Every Bone Counters turn.

state.name: self.sow_on_beat
state.description: Per player: share of on-beat drops across both counters sittings; >=70 +15 ms river window, <=40 -10 ms.

state.name: self.kept_counter
state.description: Per player: pocketed his counter piece when the lights dimmed.

state.name: self.small_one_counter
state.description: Per player: what he did with the counter the small one moved in the first sitting (accepted 2026-11-15). Phase 2 starts the second sitting from the position left.

state.name: run.gifts
state.description: Every gift carved.

state.name: self.gift_given
state.description: Per player: form of the tool he carved.

state.name: self.gift_received
state.description: Per player: form of the tool carved for him.

state.name: self.gift_quality
state.description: Per player: quality of the gift he holds (true >=80%, rough 60-79%, keepsake <60%).

state.name: self.gift_marked
state.description: Per player: the gift he holds carries his mark; +20 ms grip window at the heart.

state.name: self.underside_cut
state.description: Per player: the sign he cut on the inside face of the gift he carved, for 2 strokes (the Underside, accepted 2026-11-15).

state.name: self.underside_held
state.description: Per player: the Underside on the gift he holds. Nothing shows it to him until s3_vessel.

state.name: run.song
state.description: The Marrow-Song as arranged.

state.name: run.song_harmony
state.description: Song harmony; >=75 +15 ms river window for all, <=40 -10 ms.

state.name: run.song_complete
state.description: Verse one sung; starts the 2-minute count to the Recognition.

state.name: run.song_last_beat
state.description: Beat of the heart verse's last note, counted from the start of singing in the heart.

state.name: self.refused
state.description: Per player: sat on the elders' bench at the Recognition and stayed.

state.name: run.stayers
state.description: Players who stayed.

state.name: run.climb_lifts
state.description: Lifts completed on the climb; run.sync starts at 50 + 3 x lifts, max 70.

state.name: run.stayer_beat
state.description: The stayer's pulse-wall timing; up to +15 ms on the raft's window, fading by chapter (full c5, 60% c6, 30% c7, none c8). The wall carries the beat only, never voices.

state.name: run.sync
state.description: Group timing on the river; >=70 speed x1.25, <=30 yaw and splashes.

state.name: self.saw_raft_mark
state.description: Per player: at boarding he laid a hand on the pale patch in the raft's flank and knew the mark from the empty seat (accepted 2026-11-15).

state.name: self.in_time
state.description: Per player: share of rowing beats stroked on the beat, river and delta.

state.name: run.notice
state.description: Immune beasts' notice during patrols; at 100 one brother is taken.

state.name: self.exposure
state.description: Per player: his share of notice; the highest is taken.

state.name: run.taken_count
state.description: Brothers taken by an immune beast; capped at 1. At 1 no hands can lock at the heart (a cost to the whole raft).

state.name: run.taken_seat
state.description: Seat of the taken brother.

state.name: self.taken
state.description: Per player: he was taken into the hold. Decides Taken by the River for him alone.

state.name: self.scout_pings
state.description: Per player: hazards pinged from the hold by a taken brother.

state.name: self.hold_kept_gift
state.description: Per player (taken): his gift is still in his hand when the beast turns away. Holding it with both hands stops it sinking into the hold's skin and stops him knocking (accepted 2026-11-15).

state.name: run.route
state.description: Branch Chart choices.

state.name: run.calm_count
state.description: Calm pools reached; one in the delta gives the heart verse 2 minutes.

state.name: run.saw_finished_board
state.description: The Fourth Branch carried the vote at the last junction and the raft saw the Finished Board in the backwater (accepted 2026-11-15).

state.name: self.next_counter_carved
state.description: Per player (stayer): finished the counter for the next group's child.

state.name: self.taught_pulse
state.description: Per player (stayer): kept time with the child for 16 drops in a row.

state.name: self.grip
state.description: Per player: grip at the heart; drains each beat, re-squeezed on the beat.

state.name: self.held_together
state.description: Per player: his hand locked with another's on the song's last note.

state.name: self.swept_order
state.description: Per player: order of separation at the heart (1 = first).

state.name: run.separations
state.description: Each separation at the heart, in order, shared so the stayer's wall can skip a beat for each and every client can cut that brother's voice.

state.name: run.dropins
state.description: Companion drop-ins for disconnected players.

state.name: self.colour
state.description: Per player: colour as a state. Red climbs with self.in_time (under 60 blue, 60 to 84 turning, 85 and over red); a Warden's eye finds the bluest brother first (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: run.blue_seat
state.description: The seat of the bluest brother at the Blue Arm: the eye stays open until he is hidden (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: self.hid_blue_arm
state.description: Per player: times he trimmed to the blue arm's side to hide him from the open eye (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: self.inspected
state.description: Per player: held his arm out, still, for four beats at the Inspection (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: run.song_rests
state.description: Rest beads set in the song (at most four in a verse). The Wardens' eyes open on these beats, where nobody rows (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: run.song_child
state.description: The small one's wrong-note phrase stands in the heart verse; it breaks one join and is the only phrase he will remember (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: run.song_hollow
state.description: Brothers whose phrases are hollow beads in the heart verse (they stayed or were taken): the slot is kept and sounds as silence (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: run.song_ends_on_gap
state.description: The group chose to end the heart verse on a hollow bead (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16). Phase 3 reads it; nothing in phase 2 depends on it.

state.name: self.gift_fit
state.description: Per player: the gift he holds was cut for his hand (the side he rows and a wide or narrow grip). He switches sides in one beat and his squeeze window at the heart is wider; a tool cut for the wrong hand is never better than rough (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: run.board_left
state.description: The board as the first sitting left it, the small one's counter included; the second sitting starts from it (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: self.board_row
state.description: Per player: the row he left at the cut. Read as five heights (an empty hollow is a silent beat) it is the phrase he is offered for the heart verse, and the raft hums it at boarding (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: self.lent_counters
state.description: Per player: counters lent from his keep for his opponent to sow once from his own row (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: self.old_counter
state.description: Per player: he made the one move on the oldest board, and an elder closed his fingers round its last counter (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: run.dissent
state.description: Pieces that stood against the winning branch at the last junction: each is one eddy in the next stretch (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: run.saw_chart_back
state.description: The awl pricked through and the chart was held to the light: no vessel leaves the heart beside another (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: run.stencil_gap
state.description: The group's row on the Stencil Wall has three hands and a gap: someone stayed (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: self.stencil_pressed
state.description: Per player: pressed the bare row on the beat with the others; the press sets run.sync (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).

state.name: self.felt_warm_seat
state.description: Per player: touched the empty seat on the elders' bench and found it warm; its elder left the night before (accepted 2026-11-15, built 2026-11-16).
